# Session 5: Return to Saltmere

The party returned to Saltmere with the letter. Brother Aldric greeted them at the shrine, alive and well, and blessed Dorran's blade.

Oswin Pell, now 60 years old, admitted that two more boats vanished while the party was away.

Iska confronted Captain Rhosyn Dace at the Drowned Lantern. Rhosyn Dace admitted the Tidebound have seen grey-robed figures rowing toward Greywatch Lighthouse at night. The Tidebound agreed to lend the party a boat.

Bettany Crane told Sefa that her brother vanished in the spring and begged the party to bring him home.
